wiki.title: Matt Dubnik
wiki.extract: Matthew Scott Dubnik ( DOOB-nik; born March 30, 1981) is an American politician who has served in the Georgia House of Representatives from the 29th district since 2017. He is also chief engagement officer of Forum Communications, a Georgia-based marketing company. He attended Lakeview Academy, a private school in Gainesville, Georgia, and received his bachelor's degree in management and information technology from Georgia Institute of Technology.
